answer: Your most recent HbA1c was 6.9% on 16 February 2026. That is the latest result in your records, so it is now about eight months old. Your HbA1c was 7.1% in August 2025 and 8.3% in January 2025, so it has come down over the past year. Ask your doctor when the next one is due, since it is usually checked every three to six months.
